Tosafot on Bava Batra 130a:10:1.hebrew: האי מלא יוכל לבכר נפקא - פירוש: מדקאמר רחמנא דחלק בכורה אין יכול לשנות, מכלל דחלק פשיטות יכול לשנות. ולמה לי קרא דביום הנחילו את בניו? והוה מצי למימר: ולטעמיך, לרבנן נמי יקשה, אמאי אינו יכול לשנות חלק פשיטות? הא כיון דכתיב "לא יוכל לבכר", מכלל דחלק פשיטות יכול:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 130a:10:1.english: "This is derived from 'he may not give the firstborn rights'" - Explanation: Since the Merciful One said that [the father] cannot change the firstborn's portion, it follows by implication that he can change the ordinary portion. So why do I need the verse "on the day he causes his sons to inherit"? And one could have said: According to your reasoning, it would be difficult for the Rabbis as well: why can he not change the ordinary portion? After all, since it is written "he may not give the firstborn rights," it follows by implication that he can [change] the ordinary portion:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 130a:8:1.hebrew: הלכה כר' יוחנן בן ברוקה - נראה דדוקא בן בין הבנים ובת בין הבנות, כפירוש רבינו שמואל:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 130a:8:1.english: The halakhah is in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka - It appears that [this applies] specifically [to the case of] a son among the sons, and a daughter among the daughters, as per the explanation of Rabbeinu Shmuel:
